visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a dark hoodie and dark pants jumps enthusiastically onto a bed with beige sheets in a room with white walls and a dark floor. A tall floor lamp stands nearby to the left of the bed. (2) He stands in a modern kitchen with white tile backsplash and dark cabinetry, using both hands to operate a high-end silver espresso machine that is pouring coffee into a brown mug. (3) He sits at a wooden desk with a grey laptop open, showing a detailed digital to-do list. He holds the brown mug to his lips, taking a sip while looking at the screen. (4) The man reclines in a wooden lounge chair, holding an orange-covered book with large black text entitled "The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F*ck". A Marshall speaker sits on a table in the background. (5) A montage displays his various work activities: typing rapidly on his laptop, leaning his head on his hand in a thinking posture, and having a video conference with four people on his screen. (6) He wears a red and black plaid shirt over his hoodie, puts on a grey backpack, and walks toward the camera before exiting a white door into a hallway. (7) He is seen inside a car, wearing a seatbelt over his plaid shirt, looking stressed and rubbing his forehead with his hand while driving through a suburban area during the day. (8) He holds a Snickers candy bar in its blue and red wrapper, tears it open, and takes a large bite, followed by a wide smile as pink floral graphics appear. (9) He walks outdoors along a quiet street lined with white two-story modern houses, holding a camera mounted on a black stabilizer to film himself as he speaks. (10) Inside the car again, he holds up a Snickers Almond bar and a Snickers Butterscotch bar, displaying them clearly to the camera while gesturing with his free hand. (11) The video concludes with a screen showing a text overlay about a promotional discount at FamilyMart stores against the background of the car interior and a product image.
